entries.title: Genesis 32:1
segments: ¶So Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

entries.title: Genesis 32:2
segments: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This [is] God's camp." And he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

entries.title: Genesis 32:3
segments: ¶Then Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 32:4
segments: And he commanded them, saying, "Speak thus to my lord Esau, 'Thus your servant Jacob says: "I have dwelt with Laban and stayed there until now.

entries.title: Genesis 32:5
segments: "I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, and male and female servants; and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight."'"

entries.title: Genesis 32:6
segments: Then the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and he also is coming to meet you, and four hundred men [are] with him."

entries.title: Genesis 32:7
segments: So Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed; and he divided the people that [were] with him, and the flocks and herds and camels, into two companies.

entries.title: Genesis 32:8
segments: And he said, "If Esau comes to the one company and attacks it, then the other company which is left will escape."

entries.title: Genesis 32:9
segments: ¶Then Jacob said, "O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, the LORD who said to me, 'Return to your country and to your family, and I will deal well with you':

entries.title: Genesis 32:10
segments: "I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies and of all the truth which You have shown Your servant; for I crossed over this Jordan with my staff, and now I have become two companies.

entries.title: Genesis 32:11
segments: "Deliver me, I pray, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and attack me [and] the mother with the children.

entries.title: Genesis 32:12
segments: "For You said, 'I will surely treat you well, and make your descendants as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.'"

entries.title: Genesis 32:13
segments: ¶So he lodged there that same night, and took what came to his hand as a present for Esau his brother:

entries.title: Genesis 32:14
segments: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

entries.title: Genesis 32:15
segments: thirty milk camels with their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

entries.title: Genesis 32:16
segments: Then he delivered [them] to the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said to his servants, "Pass over before me, and put some distance between successive droves."

entries.title: Genesis 32:17
segments: And he commanded the first one, saying, "When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, saying, 'To whom do you belong, and where are you going? Whose [are] these in front of you?'

entries.title: Genesis 32:18
segments: "then you shall say, 'They [are] your servant Jacob's. It [is] a present sent to my lord Esau; and behold, he also [is] behind us.'"

entries.title: Genesis 32:19
segments: So he commanded the second, the third, and all who followed the droves, saying, "In this manner you shall speak to Esau when you find him;

entries.title: Genesis 32:20
segments: "and also say, 'Behold, your servant Jacob [is] behind us.'" For he said, "I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; perhaps he will accept me."

entries.title: Genesis 32:21
segments: So the present went on over before him, but he himself lodged that night in the camp.

entries.title: Genesis 32:22
segments: And he arose that night and took his two wives, his two female servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of Jabbok.

entries.title: Genesis 32:23
segments: He took them, sent them over the brook, and sent over what he had.

entries.title: Genesis 32:24
segments: ¶Then Jacob was left alone; and a Man wrestled with him until the breaking of day.

entries.title: Genesis 32:25
segments: Now when He saw that He did not prevail against him, He touched the socket of his hip; and the socket of Jacob's hip was out of joint as He wrestled with him.

entries.title: Genesis 32:26
segments: And He said, "Let Me go, for the day breaks." But he said, "I will not let You go unless You bless me!"

entries.title: Genesis 32:27
segments: So He said to him, "What [is] your name?" He said, "Jacob."

entries.title: Genesis 32:28
segments: And He said, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have struggled with God and with men, and have prevailed."

entries.title: Genesis 32:29
segments: Then Jacob asked, saying, "Tell [me] Your name, I pray." And He said, "Why [is] it [that] you ask about My name?" And He blessed him there.

entries.title: Genesis 32:30
segments: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: "For I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved."

entries.title: Genesis 32:31
segments: Just as he crossed over Penuel the sun rose on him, and he limped on his hip.

entries.title: Genesis 32:32
segments: Therefore to this day the children of Israel do not eat the muscle that shrank, which [is] on the hip socket, because He touched the socket of Jacob's hip in the muscle that shrank.
